purpose: Define the contract for row-level uncertainty provenance in the first fixed-CI/correlated kernel lane before any accepted correction operator exists.
required_inputs: locked uncertainty policy with required row-level field schema
accepted operator parameter uncertainties or explicit noncomputability reasons
source-backed observable uncertainties or rounding bounds
row-level provenance linking uncertainty to emitted operator state
required_outputs: row-level uncertainty fields aligned with the uncertainty policy
machine-readable uncertainty provenance per emitted row
claim-boundary flag preventing validation-ready use before accepted operator provenance exists

required_checks.requirement: The target module exposes the row-level uncertainty contract entrypoint.
The contract explicitly depends on the parameterized correction-emission scaffold instead of skipping emission provenance.
The contract explicitly binds itself to the locked operator uncertainty policy.
The contract lists required inputs and outputs explicitly rather than leaving uncertainty provenance expectations implicit.
The contract still states that accepted row-level uncertainty provenance is not implemented, so diagnostic rows cannot be upgraded into validation-ready operator uncertainty.

claim_boundary: This manifest defines the row-level uncertainty provenance contract only. It does not emit accepted operator uncertainty rows, close validation-ready thresholds, or validate a correction operator.
